login.title: Sign in
login.description: Continue learning and practising with your English9x account.
login.errorGoogle: Google sign-in did not work. Please try again.
login.errorGoogleUnverified: Google has not confirmed this email address, so we cannot link or create an account. Verify the address with Google, or sign in with email and password.

register.title: Create an account
register.description: Sign up to study IELTS and TOEIC courses on English9x.
register.consent: I agree that English9x collects and processes my personal data (name, email, study results) to provide the service, as set out in Decree 13/2023/ND-CP.
register.sentBody: If this address can be used to sign up, an email with a verification link has been sent to {{email}}. Open the link in the email to finish. It is valid for 24 hours.
register.resent: If this account is still waiting for verification, a new email has been sent.

verify.title: Verify your email
verify.successBody: Thank you. Your account is ready.
verify.failBody: The link is invalid, already used, or has expired. Enter your email to get a new one.
verify.missingToken: The verification link is incomplete. Enter your email to get a new one.

forgot.title: Forgot your password
forgot.description: Enter the email of your account. We will send a link to choose a new password.
forgot.sentBody: If an account uses this email, a password reset link has been sent. It is valid for 1 hour and works once.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.description: Choose a new password for your account. Every older session will be signed out.
reset.missingToken: The reset link is incomplete. Please request a new one.
reset.doneBody: You can now sign in with the new password.

google.consentBody: Before your account can be used, English9x needs your agreement to process your personal data.
google.replaceBody: This browser is signed in as {{name}}. Did you just sign in with Google yourself? If you followed a link from someone else, keep your current session.
google.replaceBodyNoName: This browser already has a signed-in session. Did you just sign in with Google yourself? If you followed a link from someone else, keep your current session.

banner.unverified: Your email is not verified yet. You can study, but you need to verify it before buying a plan.
banner.resent: Verification email sent. Please check your inbox.
